name: 90270 · Maywood, CA
findings: ZIP 90270 (Maywood) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.
